[SWS_CM_99039] Method response message separation time
Upstream requirements:
RS_SOMEIP_00051
⌈
If attribute
SomeipMethodDeployment
.
separationTimeResponse
is set, and
segmentation is activated for the corresponding SOME/IP method response mes-
sage according to [SWS_CM_99038], the segments shall be separated in time by this
value.
⌋
